item.title: As US battles China on AI, some companies choose Chinese tech

item.title: Engine idling law nets 660 fines amid 13,500 complaints since 2011 implementation
item.description: Hong Kong authorities have issued 660 fixed penalty notices since 2011 after engine idling was banned to reduce air pollution. The Environmental Protection Department and police received a total of 13,585 reports or complaints against vehicles with idling engines between December 15, 2011, and September 30 2025, according to data provided by the government following […]

item.title: ‘Makes me feel young again’: Shanghai’s elderly waltz back to the past at lunchtime dance halls
item.description: A group of retirees cheered under disco lights as 60-year-old Xu Li leapt into her partner’s arms, her legs spread akimbo in perfect splits. item.title: 2025 in Pictures: Sporting landmarks, panda twins, record-breaking weather and LGBT+ setbacks

item.title: Disputed Myanmar elections win China’s vote of confidence
item.description: Myanmar’s military-run elections are being pilloried abroad and shunned at home, but neighbouring China has emerged as an enthusiastic backer of the pariah poll. item.title: Hongkongers bid farewell to ‘king of umbrellas’ as 183-year-old family business comes to a close
